summary: EBR Systems, Inc. filed an 8-K announcing the impending departure of Chief Commercial Officer Erik Strandberg, not due to any dispute or disagreement. CEO John McCutcheon will assume commercial responsibilities while a successor search begins. The company expects to enter a departure agreement later and will disclose terms via amendment. A press release was furnished as Exhibit 99.1. This is a routine executive transition with no special-situation financial terms, advisors, or structural mechanics. Watch for the eventual departure agreement terms and successor appointment.
